note: The exposed surface of this node. The gateway builds its tool list from this file and refuses to start when a declared endpoint has no reachable implementation, so a written-but-unbuilt operation cannot become a tool. Services standing PROPOSED are absent on purpose. Each endpoint names the service manifest operation it realizes, or states that no manifest declares it yet - the gap is recorded rather than papered over.

tiers.read: No grant, no writes. Answers what the state is.
tiers.observe: Runs a check and appends an OBSERVATION entry. Changes no service state.
tiers.act: Requires a live session. The gate is either the gateway's own capability check or the service's, and every act endpoint declares which. Appends an EVENT, then a RECEIPT carrying the outcome.

endpoints.description: Open a bounded session for this participant and model identity. Every later act-tier call carries the returned session id, and closing the session withdraws every grant issued under it.
endpoints.undeclared_because: The asset service implements sessions; no service manifest declares them as an operation.

endpoints.description: Issue a live, expiring grant bound to the current session. The Authority layer owns the check: the store's recorded root may issue, and anyone else may only issue what one of their own live grants already covers, so a delegated grant narrows and never widens.
endpoints.undeclared_because: The asset service implements grants; no service manifest declares them as an operation.

endpoints.description: Capture a local file as an addressed source and its original version. Returns the asset, source, version, digest, and receipt identifiers.
Assets whose projected text contains the query. Reads a rebuildable projection, never the canonical record.
endpoints.undeclared_because: Reads the search projection. The asset manifest declares read-asset, which is not the same operation.

endpoints.description: Every entry in the operational journal, in append order, with its digest chain.
Run scripts/verify.py and append the result as an OBSERVATION. Establishes BUILT evidence only; it witnesses and ratifies nothing.
endpoints.undeclared_because: A repository check, not a service operation. No manifest declares it and none should.

authority_modes.gateway: The gateway requires the caller to hold the declared capability.
authority_modes.service-enforced: The service owns the check. The gateway adds no second, stricter rule it has no bootstrap for.
authority_modes.bootstrap: Establishes the session the other endpoints require, so it cannot itself require one.
